tasks.label: install
tasks.detail: Sync the virtualenv with every dependency and extra (make install).

tasks.label: test: unit suite (coverage)
tasks.detail: Run the offline test suite with coverage (make test).

tasks.label: test: unit suite (fast, no coverage)
tasks.detail: Run every non-integration test without coverage instrumentation.

tasks.label: test: integration suite
tasks.detail: Start the otel-collector and run the opt-in integration suite (make test-integration).

tasks.label: collector: up
tasks.detail: Start the otel-collector used by the integration suite.

tasks.label: lint: all
tasks.detail: Run ruff check, ruff format --check, and mypy (make lint).

tasks.label: pre-commit: all files
tasks.detail: Run every pre-commit hook against all files, matching CI's 'linting' job.

tasks.label: CI: replicate 'test' job
tasks.detail: Runs the same steps as the CI 'test' job locally: ruff check, ruff format --check, mypy, then pytest with coverage.
